content.value: Mr. Rahman started a business on June 01, 2024. The following transactions during (35) [CO2] June:
June-01 Invested cash for the business TK 3,50,000.
57 02 Purchase a Delivery Van for the business in cash TK 40,000.
77 - 03 Equipment purchase for office use in cash TK 20,000.
75 04 A fee of TK 12,000 for the hauling goods is billed to a customer on account.
05 Cash received from customer transaction June 04.
75 07 Repair expense paid by cheque TK 10,000.
79 08 Advertisement expense occurred in the Daily Bangladesh Pratidin on account TK 7,000.
09 Supplies purchase for office use in cash TK 9,000.
55 10 Advertisement bill paid by cheque transaction June 08.

ii) Prepare a tabular summary and show the effect on accounting equation. Mr. Rahman arrange the assets and liabilities are: Cash + Delivery Van + Equipment + Supplies = Accounts Payable + Rahman's Capital.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
